newsitem.title: DUBAI: Royal Brunei launches new Abu Dhabi-London flight.
newsitem.headline: Royal Brunei launches new Abu Dhabi-London flight.

text.p: Royal Brunei Airlines on Monday launched its seventh flight linking the United Arab Emirates and London, the airline said.

With the new flight, which will route through Abu Dhabi, Royal Brunei will be offering a daily service from the UAE to London, the airline said. Four will route through Dubai and three through Abu Dhabi, it said.
Royal Brunei's Middle East area manager Feroze Khan said the new flight was part of the airline's plan for further regional expansion.
"I look forward to making further announcements on new services in 1997, starting with a Dubai-Muscat service in the first half of the year," he said. -- Dubai newsroom +9714-6071-219
